Crystal Seeds are how you grow Pure Crystals without mining. Craft them from dust and drop them into water. Three types exist:

§b-§f Certus Quartz Seed: grows into Pure Certus Quartz Crystal
§b-§f Nether Quartz Seed: grows into Pure Nether Quartz Crystal
§b-§f Fluix Seed: grows into Pure Fluix Crystal

Each seed goes through 3 growth stages in water, producing 1 Pure Crystal at stage completion. Growth is slow without help, but a Crystal Growth Accelerator placed adjacent to the water speeds things up dramatically. Multiple accelerators stack.

Pure Crystals are essential for processors and advanced AE2 components. Set up a dedicated growing pool with accelerators as soon as you can.

§ePS:§f Seeds do not despawn. Toss a stack in water and come back later.
